observation.command: t=$(timeout 40 curl -s "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities&version=2.0.0" | grep -oE "<TypeName>[^<]+</TypeName>" | head -1 | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g'); echo "typename: $t"; timeout 60 curl -s "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetFeature&version=2.0.0&typeNames=$t&maxFeatures=1" -o /tmp/gf2.xml -w "GetFeature: %{http_code}, %{size_download} bytes\n"
